messages:
Ava: Morning! Anyone up for streaming the 3pm match in the kitchen? I'm bringing a big thermos of cold brew :coffee: and maybe bagels. Also — fantasy poll: who’s punting QB this week?
Jamal: I’m in for coffee. :raised_hands: Also punting QB unless we get a miracle trade.
Leah: Bagels + soccer = yes. I can grab cream cheese. What channel are we using for the stream?
Carlos: I’ll bring the Bluetooth speaker and a mini cooler for sodas. If we can mirror from my laptop that’s easiest.
Ava: Perfect. Kitchen TV is free — can someone bring an HDMI cable?
Jamal: I have one in my desk drawer. Will drop it at 2:45.
Leah: For the punt question — I’m benching my QB and starting the flex WR. Risky but lol.
Carlos: Low-key tempted to throw a $5 winner-takes-all on halftime score. Anyone? :moneybag:
Ava: Haha only if you promise not to make us hear about it for a week :joy:
DevBot: Reminder: All-hands in 4 hours — please don’t schedule mandatory watch parties during it :robot_face:
Jamal: Noted. All-hands > soccer maybe. We’ll keep it casual and optional.
Leah: Quick poll: who wants sesame, plain, or everything bagels? Reply with :thumbsup: for sesame, :heart: for everything, :smile: for plain.
Carlos: :thumbsup:
Ava: :heart:
Jamal: :heart:
Leah: Sweet. I’ll grab a mix. See y’all at 2:45ish.
Ava: Legends. If anyone needs me to bring anything else, shout here or DM.
